_Note: Ensure to rewrite the default issue title to capture a very brief summary (several words at most) of what the proposed docs improvement/change is._

_E.g. docs/add-missing-api-config-step_

**User Story:**
Explain what the docs improvement being suggested is, what files it affects and why its important to the project.

**What does successful implementation look like?:**
I.e. How do we verify the change was implemented successfully? I.e. what files are now updated or broken links did you patch etc.?

**Additional context:**
Add any other context or screenshots about the docs change/improvement here.
